solutions.title: Four Ways to Trade Network Capacity
solutions.subtitle: Mobile networks are expensive to build and often sit half empty. These four products let operators share what they already have — automatically.

items.title: Network Sharing Exchange
items.description: We predict where a network will be crowded and where it will be quiet. Then we automatically match operators who need extra capacity with those who have spare capacity — no meetings, no manual contracts.

items.title: Slice Exchange
items.description: Some mobile brands rent their network from bigger operators. Instead of being locked into a fixed monthly amount, they can buy exactly what they need, when they need it, from more than one provider.

items.title: Private Network Marketplace
items.description: A stadium, factory or hospital can run its own small network. When an event or a busy shift needs more, they buy extra coverage for just that period — and it works beyond their own walls.

items.title: Neutral Host Trading Platform
items.description: A neutral middleman that connects everyone. It finds unused capacity, sets a fair price in real time, and closes the deal on its own — so idle equipment starts earning.

about.title: Where Spare Capacity Finds a Home
paragraphs: TEASOL enables operators to unlock the full potential of their infrastructure through intelligent sharing and slice management solutions.

Founded by telecom veterans with 35+ years of experience in network virtualization, AI and infrastructure innovation, we are building the first fully automated network sharing exchange for the 5G/6G era.
